key.name: language
key.description: Interface language code (e.g. 'ru', 'en') or empty string for system locale.

key.name: opponent
key.description: Opponent type: 'computer' or 'human'.

key.name: ai-difficulty
key.description: Difficulty level: 'master' or 'standard'.

key.name: game-speed
key.description: Game speed: 'slow' or 'fast'.

key.name: board-theme
key.description: Theme style: 'marble' or 'wood'.

key.name: movement-type
key.description: Movement type: 'arc' or 'straight'.

key.name: use-board-dice-animation
key.description: Whether to animate dice roll directly on the board.

key.name: show-path-computer
key.description: Display trajectory arrows for computer moves.

key.name: show-path-player
key.description: Display trajectory arrows for player moves.

key.name: highlight-log-paths
key.description: Highlight board paths when hovering or selecting turns in log.

key.name: show-cell-indices
key.description: Display 1-24 numbering on board points.

key.name: enable-debug-export
key.description: Export detailed game state debug logs.

key.name: score-display-mode
key.description: Score display format: 'progress' or 'score'.

key.name: is-sound-enabled
key.description: Whether sound effects are played.

key.name: is-first-move-rolloff-enabled
key.description: Whether players roll dice to determine who moves first.

key.name: board-side
key.description: Side where head checkers start: 'right' or 'left'.

key.name: is-drag-and-drop-enabled
key.description: Allow moving checkers via drag and drop.

key.name: white-player-name
key.description: Custom name for the white checker player.

key.name: black-player-name
key.description: Custom name for the black checker player.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Saved main window width in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Saved main window height in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized.
